scripts.translation:

scripts.text: About the request.
scripts.translation: 关于请求

scripts.text:
[Woodworker]
Are you talking about a request~ customer~?
Could you wait a moment, please~?
scripts.translation:
[木工]
您说的是请求~顾客~？
请稍等片刻~？

scripts.text:
[Woodworker]
The carpentry request...
Hm...
scripts.translation:
[木工]
木工的请求...
嗯...

scripts.text:
[Woodworker]
I'm sorry, but it's confirmed that there's no request from our woodwork.
May I know what kind of request you've received? Customer~
scripts.translation:
[木工]
很抱歉，确认过我们木工店没有发出请求。
请问您收到的是什么样的请求？顾客~

scripts.text: Request for firewood.
scripts.translation: 柴薪请求

scripts.text:
[Woodworker]
Aaah!!!
I'm sorry!
I don't think it's from the woodworking shop, but it's a personal request from the owner~
scripts.translation:
[木工]
啊！！！
对不起！
我想这不是木工店的请求，而是老板的个人请求~

scripts.text:
[Woodworker]
<FONT SIZE = 10>If the boss asked you to do it, you should've told me!</FONT>
May I have a moment, please? Customer?
I'll call the boss...
scripts.translation:
[木工]
<FONT SIZE = 10>如果老板让您做的，您应该告诉我！</FONT>
请给我一点时间，好吗？顾客？
我去叫老板...

scripts.text:
[Woodworker]
<FONT SIZE = 14>This gentleman is out and gone again!!</FONT>
<FONT SIZE = 10>Did he go to the forest again!</FONT>
This can't be happening!!!
scripts.translation:
[木工]
<FONT SIZE = 14>这位先生又不在！</FONT>
<FONT SIZE = 10>他又去森林了！</FONT>
这可真是...

scripts.text:
[Woodworker]
I'm sorry~ Customer.
The boss is out of the office right now.
scripts.translation:
[木工]
很抱歉~顾客。
老板现在不在办公室。

scripts.text:
[Woodworker]
I don't know when he'll be back.
If you're in a hurry, why don't you go to ^dd5555Payon Forest^000000?
You go <NAVI>[there]<INFO>pay_fild08,157,129,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>.
scripts.translation:
[木工]
我不知道他什么时候回来。
如果您很着急，不妨去^dd5555斐扬树林^000000看看？
您可以去<NAVI>[那里]<INFO>pay_fild08,157,129,0,101,0</INFO></NAVI>。

scripts.translation:

<FONT SIZE = 14>欢迎~顾客~！</FONT>

scripts.text:
[Woodworker]
Do you have any other business?
scripts.translation:
[木工]
还有其他事情吗？

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Firewood]
Aaaah~~
I'm completely blown away today! I messed up!!!
scripts.translation:
[木匠 柴薪]
啊啊~~
今天真是彻底崩溃了！我搞砸了！！！

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Firewood]
Aaaah~~
I'm completely blown away today! I messed up!!!
scripts.translation:
[木匠 柴薪]
啊啊~~
今天真是彻底崩溃了！我搞砸了！！！

scripts.text: Chief?
scripts.translation: 首领？

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Firewood]
Who?
...
Did Lee Daegam send you?
scripts.translation:
[木匠 柴薪]
谁？
...
是李大监派你来的吗？

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Firewood]
How long has it been since you roasted it? Are you sending someone here again?!
Just pushing doesn't mean it's going to work!
scripts.translation:
[木匠 柴薪]
烤了多久了？你们又派人来了吗？！
光靠催促可解决不了问题啊！

scripts.text: I came for the request.
scripts.translation: 我是来执行委托的

scripts.text: [Carpenter Firewood] Huh... Huh... Ah!!!!!!!!!
scripts.translation: [木匠 柴薪] 啊... 啊... 啊！！！！！！！！

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Firewood]
Eheh~~!!
Aaaah!!!
<FONT SIZE = 16>That's right!!!!!</FONT>
scripts.translation:
[木匠 柴薪]
嘿嘿~~！！
啊啊啊！！！
<FONT SIZE = 16>没错！！！！！！</FONT>

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Firewood]
<FONT SIZE = 14>Sorry!</FONT>
I came out for a while because I didn't have any progress on my work and I was so frustrated, but I didn't expect a customer to visit me.
What a shame!
Eheheh!
scripts.translation:
[木匠 柴薪]
<FONT SIZE = 14>抱歉！</FONT>
因为工作毫无进展，心情很烦躁，所以出来透透气，没想到会有顾客来访。
真是太尴尬了！
嘿嘿嘿！

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Firewood]
It's the perfect timing!
Now that you've come all the way here, don't go back to the woodwork, come here and look at what the nasty beasts have done.
scripts.translation:
[木匠 柴薪]
真是时候正好！
既然你都来了，就别回去做木工活了，过来看看那些可恶的野兽干了什么好事。

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Firewood]
It looks like they're hoofed guys like deer and wild boars, but...
Why are they so fierce when they're grazing in the woods!
scripts.translation:
[木匠 柴薪]
看起来像是鹿或野猪之类的蹄类动物，但是...
为什么它们在树林里吃草的时候这么凶猛啊！

scripts.text:

为什么它们在树林里吃草的时候这么凶猛啊！

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Firewood]
So, how is your investigation going?
Have you found those wild animals yet?
scripts.translation:
[木匠 柴薪]
那么，你的调查进展如何？
找到那些野生动物了吗？

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Firewood]
What have you found, adventurer?
What have you got?
scripts.translation:
[木匠 柴薪]
你发现了什么，冒险者？
有什么发现吗？

scripts.text: About the food that fell on the street.
scripts.translation: 关于掉在街上的食物

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Firewood]
How could someone throw food on the street? Food is precious, it's such a waste!!
scripts.translation:
[木匠 柴薪]
怎么会有人把食物扔在街上呢？食物是很珍贵的，太浪费了！！

scripts.text: About wild animals.
scripts.translation: 关于野生动物

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Firewood]
I'm glad it fed some wild animals, but...
scripts.translation:
[木匠 柴薪]
很高兴能喂饱一些野生动物，但是...

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Firewood]
Then didn't the wild animals come all the way here while picking up the food?
scripts.translation:
[木匠 柴薪]
那么，那些野生动物是不是边捡食物边一路走到这里来的？

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Firewood]
Who could have done such a strange thing...
scripts.translation:
[木匠 柴薪]
到底是谁做了这么奇怪的事情...

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Firewood]
Anyway, the adventurer took over the job, so I can see some clues!
With this momentum, we'll solve this before Lee Daegam goes crazy again...
scripts.translation:
[木匠 柴薪]
总之，既然冒险者接手了这项工作，我就能看到一些线索了！
趁这股势头，在李大监再次发疯之前解决这件事...

scripts.text:
[???]
<FONT SIZE = 16>Ahem!</FONT>
<FONT SIZE = 14>Do you have a factory~</FONT>
scripts.translation:
[???]
<FONT SIZE = 16>咳！</FONT>
<FONT SIZE = 14>你们有工厂吗~</FONT>

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Firewood]
Ugh....
Eddga told me he was coming...
scripts.translation:
[木匠 柴薪]
唉....
虎王说他要来...

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Firewood]
Lee Daegam, what brings you here?
scripts.translation:
[木匠 柴薪]
李大监，您怎么来了？

scripts.text:
[Lee Daegam]
Oh~~ Eheh~ It's nothing special~
I'm here to see if everything is going well~
scripts.translation:
[李大监]
哦~~ 嘿嘿~ 没什么特别的~
我来看看这里的情况怎么样了~

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Firewood]
It won't work if you come all the time like this...
scripts.translation:
[木匠 柴薪]
您不能总是这样频繁地过来啊...

scripts.text:
[Lee Daegam]
Oh my~
It doesn't look much different from yesterday.
You didn't even start working on it, but I hear loud noises~
scripts.translation:
[李大监]
哎呀~
看起来和昨天没什么两样。
明明还没开始动工，我却听到了很大的噪音~

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Firewood]
<FONT SIZE = 14>Oh... I... I...!!!</FONT>
<FONT SIZE = 14>I can't work because the tools keep breaking down!!!</FONT>
<FONT SIZE = 14>If you're here to tease me, you're just disturbing me, so go back!</FONT>
scripts.translation:
[木匠 柴薪]
<FONT SIZE = 14>啊...我...我...!!!</FONT>
<FONT SIZE = 14>因为工具总是坏掉，所以我没法工作!!!</FONT>
<FONT SIZE = 14>如果您只是来嘲笑我的，那就别打扰我了，请回吧！</FONT>

scripts.text:
[Lee Daegam]
Oh my!
You don't have to yell that much. I'm going!
<FONT SIZE = 18>Hmph!</FONT>
scripts.translation:
[李大监]
哎呀！
不用这么大声吼我。我走了。
<FONT SIZE = 18>哼！</FONT>

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Firewood]
<FONT SIZE = 14>Oh, that old man!</FONT>
Are you asking me to work or not? You're just increasing my temper again!
scripts.translation:
[木匠 柴薪]
<FONT SIZE = 14>那个老头！</FONT>
您到底是让我工作还是不让我工作？您只会让我更生气！

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Firewood]
He's only disturbing me, let alone helping me with what I've entrusted with you.
<FONT SIZE = 14>Oh my!</FONT>
scripts.translation:
[木匠 柴薪]
他除了打扰我，对委托给我的事情毫无帮助。
<FONT SIZE = 14>真是的！</FONT>

scripts.text: About Lee Daegam.
scripts.translation: 关于李大监

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Firewood]
As you've heard before, he is a great leader, ^123456Lee Daegam^000000, who left this job to me.
scripts.translation:
[木匠 柴薪]
如您之前所听，他是一位伟大的首领，^123456李大监^000000，他把这项工作交给了我。

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Firewood]
I'll be making a vacation spot for young people around here! What do you say!
scripts.translation:
[木匠 柴薪]
我要在这里为年轻人打造一个度假胜地！您觉得怎么样！

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Firewood]
I told you that construction would be difficult because it was an area full of monsters, but who knew that even wild animals would be such a problem?
scripts.translation:
[木匠 柴薪]
我告诉过您，因为这里魔物众多，施工会很困难，但谁能想到连野生动物都会造成这么大的麻烦？

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Firewood]
In the meantime, he came to me a today and teased me like that...
If you can't solve this problem again, I think I should quit...
scripts.translation:
[木匠 柴薪]
在此期间，他今天还来嘲笑我...
如果这个问题再次无法解决，我想我应该辞职了...

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Firewood]
Then I'll be organizing my luggage in the cart.
Take a closer look at ^dd5555Broken Tools^000000.
scripts.translation:
[木匠 柴薪]
那么我要整理手推车里的行李了。
请仔细看看^dd5555损坏的工具^000000。

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Firewood]
In the meantime, he came to me a today and teased me like that...

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

请仔细看看^dd5555损坏的工具^000000。

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Firewood]
Oh my... Oh my...
How in the world could that happen...
scripts.translation:
[木匠 柴薪]
天哪... 天哪...
这到底是怎么发生的...

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Firewood]
He was a grumpy gentleman, but he wasn't that bad of a person, so what happened...
Oh my...
scripts.translation:
[木匠 柴薪]
他虽然脾气暴躁，但并不是个坏人，所以到底发生了什么...
天哪...

scripts.text: - It contains broken tools. -
scripts.translation: - 里面装着损坏的工具。-

scripts.text: - Around the box, animal footprints are imprinted in disorder, and as the Carpenter Firewood said, they appear to be herbivorous footprints. -
scripts.translation: - 箱子周围杂乱地印着动物脚印，正如木匠 柴薪所说，看起来像是食草动物的脚印。-

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Firewood]
What do you say, adventurer?
You think you know something?
scripts.translation:
[木匠 柴薪]
冒险者，您怎么看？
您觉得您知道些什么吗？

scripts.text: I think I need to look around a little more.
scripts.translation: 我觉得我需要再四处看看。

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Firewood]
Then look around carefully.
We have to start construction as soon as possible, so don't take too long.
scripts.translation:
[木匠 柴薪]
那就仔细找找看吧。
我们必须尽快开始施工，所以别花太长时间。

scripts.text:
[Carpenter Firewood]
Let me know if you find out anything while you take a look.
scripts.translation:
[木匠 柴薪]
如果你发现什么，告诉我一声。

scripts.translation: - 仔细查看损坏的工具，发现上面有一块模糊的污渍。-

scripts.text:
[Chulho]
<FONT SIZE = 16>Oh no!!</FONT>
<FONT SIZE = 14>You can't eat that!</FONT>
scripts.translation:
[哲浩]
<FONT SIZE = 16>糟糕！！</FONT>
<FONT SIZE = 14>那个不能吃！</FONT>

scripts.text:
[Chulho]
<FONT SIZE = 14>It smells delicious, but it makes you sick.</FONT>
scripts.translation:
[哲浩]
<FONT SIZE = 14>虽然闻起来很香，但吃了会生病的。</FONT>

scripts.text:
[Chulho]
<FONT SIZE = 14>The things I ate in the forest were sweet and delicious, but the snake strawberries I picked up earlier were bitter!</FONT>
<FONT SIZE = 16>I'm angry!</FONT>
<FONT SIZE = 18>My stomach hurts!</FONT>
scripts.translation:
[哲浩]
<FONT SIZE = 14>我在森林里吃的东西又甜又好吃，但我刚才摘的蛇莓却是苦的！</FONT>
<FONT SIZE = 16>气死我了！</FONT>
<FONT SIZE = 18>肚子好痛！</FONT>

scripts.text:
[Chulho]
<FONT SIZE = 14>Even the friends who followed the food here went home angry!</FONT>
scripts.translation:
[哲浩]
<FONT SIZE = 14>就连跟着食物气味来的朋友们，也都气呼呼地回家了！</FONT>

scripts.text:
[Chulho]
<FONT SIZE = 14>The road over there smells delicious, but that road is on the way to the village, so we, the mountain animals, will be in trouble if we go that way!</FONT>
scripts.translation:

<FONT SIZE = 14>Oh no!</FONT>
<FONT SIZE = 14>What's this hideous atmosphere!</FONT>
<FONT SIZE = 14>As expected, Hyunrok seems to have noticed!</FONT>
scripts.translation:
[哲浩]
<FONT SIZE = 14>糟糕！</FONT>
<FONT SIZE = 14>这气氛怎么这么诡异！</FONT>
<FONT SIZE = 14>果然，玄鹿好像察觉到了！</FONT>

scripts.text:
[Chulho]
<FONT SIZE = 14>What if we're in big trouble?</FONT>
<FONT SIZE = 14>Let's hurry up, go in and stop Hyunrok.</FONT>
scripts.translation:
[哲浩]
<FONT SIZE = 14>要是惹上大麻烦怎么办？</FONT>
<FONT SIZE = 14>快进去阻止玄鹿吧。</FONT>

scripts.text: - A suspicious ripple appears where Chulho disappeared. -
scripts.translation: - 哲浩消失的地方出现了可疑的涟漪。 -

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出。

scripts.text: ^ff0000An unknown error occurred.^000000

- The swaying looks unsettling.
Let's wait a bit and then go in. -
scripts.translation:
- 摇曳的景象令人不安。
稍等片刻再进去吧。 -

scripts.text:
- Hold on a second here!! -
- You have too many items. -
- That means you can no longer receive any items. -
- Free up some space -
- and try again. -
scripts.translation:
- 请稍等！！ -
- 您的物品栏已满。 -
- 这意味着您无法再接收任何物品。 -
- 请腾出一些空间 -
- 然后再试一次。 -

scripts.text:
[Chulho]
Please use all your skill points before proceeding.
scripts.translation:
[哲浩]
请在继续前进前使用完所有技能点。

scripts.text:
[Chulho]
<FONT SIZE = 14>I've been waiting!</FONT>
<FONT SIZE = 14>It's hard to come to the Deep Forest now, but come to think of it, I just have to come out to play!</FONT>
<FONT SIZE = 14>Although Hyunrok won't come out!</FONT>
scripts.translation:
[哲浩]
<FONT SIZE = 14>我等你很久了！</FONT>
<FONT SIZE = 14>现在去森林深处很困难，但仔细想想，只要出来玩就好了！</FONT>
<FONT SIZE = 14>虽然玄鹿不会出来！</FONT>

scripts.text:
[Chulho]
<FONT SIZE = 14>Oh, and this is a letter from Hyunrok!</FONT>
<FONT SIZE = 14>Go ahead and read it!</FONT>
scripts.translation:
[哲浩]
<FONT SIZE = 14>哦，对了，这是玄鹿的信！</FONT>
<FONT SIZE = 14>请阅读吧！</FONT>

scripts.text: Read the letter.
scripts.translation: 阅读信件

scripts.text: Stop.
scripts.translation: 停止

scripts.text:
[Hyunrok's Letter]
Dear {0}.
scripts.translation:
[玄鹿的信]
亲爱的{0}。

scripts.text:
[Hyunrok's Letter]
It's a relationship just by touching your clothes...
The reason you entered this forest and the reason we met must be all fate that the heavens decided.
scripts.translation:
[玄鹿的信]
仅仅是触碰你的衣物...你进入这片森林以及我们相遇的原因，一定是上天注定的命运。

scripts.text:
[Hyunrok's Letter]
I will never forget the grace that helped us in danger even though we did not see the relationship properly and were disrespectful in the immediate event.
scripts.translation:
[玄鹿的信]
尽管我们未能看清彼此的关系，且在紧急情况下表现得有些失礼，但我永远不会忘记在危难时刻帮助我们的恩惠。

scripts.text:
[Hyunrok's Letter]
As Chulho said, I wanted to at least hold a feast to repay you, but staying in this Deep Forest for a long time is dangerous to those outside the forest, so I feel heavy to send them back in a hurry without even telling them a proper goodbye.
scripts.translation:
[玄鹿的信]
正如哲浩所说，我想至少举办一场宴会来报答你，但长期留在森林深处对外界的人很危险，所以匆忙送他们回去，甚至没能好好道别，让我感到十分沉重。

scripts.text:
[Hyunrok's Letter]
I'm sure you'll understand because I did it for you.
scripts.translation:
[玄鹿的信]
我相信你会理解，因为我是为了你才这么做的。

scripts.text:
[Hyunrok's Letter]
And it's not a small reward for your help, but it's engraved in our souls so that we can call out our strength whenever we need help.
scripts.translation:
[玄鹿的信]
这并非对你帮助的小小回报，而是铭刻在我们灵魂中的力量，以便在需要帮助时随时召唤。

scripts.text:
[Hyunrok's Letter]
Then, let's look forward to seeing each other again...
scripts.translation:
[玄鹿的信]
那么，让我们期待再次相见...

scripts.text:
[Chulho]
<FONT SIZE = 14>Have you finished reading the letter?</FONT>
<FONT SIZE = 14>What did it say?</FONT>
scripts.translation:
[哲浩]
<FONT SIZE = 14>你读完那封信了吗？</FONT>
<FONT SIZE = 14>上面写了什么？</FONT>

scripts.text: Show the letter.
scripts.translation: 出示信件

scripts.text:
[Chulho]
<FONT SIZE = 14>Hyunrok always says things that are hard to understand!</FONT>
<FONT SIZE = 14>And take this, too!</FONT>
<FONT SIZE = 14>I saved it because it was a fun item, but I'll give it to you!</FONT>
scripts.translation:
[哲浩]
<FONT SIZE = 14>玄鹿总是说些让人难以理解的话！</FONT>
<FONT SIZE = 14>这个也拿去吧！</FONT>
<FONT SIZE = 14>我本来留着是因为它很有趣，但既然你来了，就送给你吧！</FONT>

scripts.text:
[Chulho]
<FONT SIZE = 14>See you again</FONT>
<FONT SIZE = 14>I was just out playing.</FONT>
scripts.translation:
[哲浩]
<FONT SIZE = 14>下次再见</FONT>
<FONT SIZE = 14>我刚才只是出来玩而已。</FONT>

scripts.text:
[Chulho]
<FONT SIZE = 14>There's so much fun outside the forest!</FONT>
<FONT SIZE = 14>Of course the forest is fun too!</FONT>
scripts.translation:
[哲浩]
<FONT SIZE = 14>森林外面有好多好玩的事情！</FONT>
<FONT SIZE = 14>当然，森林里也很好玩！</FONT>
